seed: Assume positions live on a lattice. Infer the step size and bounds from the data and write movement as lattice moves with explicit bound and obstacle checks.

synth.notes:
Lights-out board on lattice step 8 (6x6 cells); only ACTION6 clicks act, hit-tested against object bboxes.
tile: click toggles color_14<->color_15.
operator: click toggles own marker_14<->15 plus tiles one lattice step away (+-8 in x/y); glyph neighbours untouched.
glyph and empty-cell clicks, non-click actions: no-op. Stateless.
Unconfirmed: whether operators chain into neighbouring operators (never observed; assumed not).
